in_hebrew.name: Leoron
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Leoron הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Hebrew, Leoron means 'light' or 'bright' and can be derived from the Hebrew word leor (light) or the Greek word leon (lion). In the Bible, the name Leoron is not directly associated with a specific character but is believed to evoke images of strength, courage, and illumination. Leoron may be a fitting name for a son seeking to embody these qualities and shine his light in the world.
